text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, shifting between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. The narrative tone varies depending on the speaker, moving from the optimistic and curious voice of the scientist to the pragmatic and cautious voice of the engineer. Additionally, the language style adapts to the subject matter, utilizing technical terminology when describing machinery and phenomena, while becoming more reflective and philosophical when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
